answer: An agent market for onyx and copper can require each voting identity to lock a refundable bond for 30 days, with voting power proportional to the amount locked. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake agents still yields only 100 tokens of influence, so extra names create no ripple of extra votes. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more capital, paying its financing cost and losing access to it during the lock.
